procedure_column: Chernonozhkin et al. 2021 (Chem Geol 562) Pallasite olivine Raster mapping (2D) ns-LA-SF-ICP-MS Ghent University

Procedure Name.cell: Chernonozhkin et al. (2021) Pallasite Olivine 2D Mapping v1
Procedure Name.value: Chernonozhkin et al. (2021) Pallasite Olivine 2D Mapping v1

Procedure Author.cell: Chernonozhkin, Pittarello, Goderis, Vanhaecke et al.
Procedure Author.value: Chernonozhkin, Pittarello, Goderis, Vanhaecke et al.

Laboratory.cell: Dept. of Chemistry, Atomic & Mass Spectrometry, Ghent University, Belgium
Laboratory.value: Dept. of Chemistry, Atomic & Mass Spectrometry, Ghent University, Belgium

Funding Source for Procedure Development.cell: N — the BELSPO, FWO, BOF-UGent and Humboldt support is for the study as a whole and is recorded under Funding Source for Analysis

Procedure Reference(s).cell: Chernonozhkin et al. (2021) Chem. Geol. 562; Liu et al. (2008) for IS method
Procedure Reference(s).value: Chernonozhkin et al. (2021) Chem. Geol. 562; Liu et al. (2008) for IS method

Sampling Unit Type.cell: Grain (individual olivine crystal) > Region of interest (2D map) — "2D trace element mapping of olivine crystals" (p.1); the reported dataset is "seven 2D element maps of PMG olivine crystals", filtered and median-smoothed before analysis (p.6)
Sampling Unit Type.value: Grain (individual olivine crystal) > Region of interest (2D map)

Sampling Unit Selection Criteria.cell: Position relative to the metal-olivine rim, sited on a prior μXRF survey — "The locations for LA-ICP-MS mapping were selected to be close to the metal-olivine rims of large olivine crystals with the laser beam rastering from the olivine rim in the direction of the olivine core", at locations "indicated on the larger μXRF maps as black rectangles" (p.4)
Sampling Unit Selection Criteria.value: Position relative to the metal-olivine rim, sited on a prior μXRF survey

Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening.cell: μXRF mapping of larger sections, on which the ablation is sited — Fe Kα intensity maps identify the mineral phases "based on the intensities of the Kα lines of the constituent major elements (Fe, Mg, Ni, Cr, S, Ca and P)", and the LA-ICP-MS areas correspond "to the locations indicated on the larger μXRF maps as black rectangles" (p.4). The instrument is a Bruker M4 Tornado with a Rh-anode source at 50 kV and 150 μA, focused to "a 25 μm spot (measured for Mo Kα)" (p.3)
Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening.value: μXRF mapping of larger sections, on which the ablation is sited

Laser Manufacturer & Model.cell: Teledyne CETAC Technologies Analyte G2 (193 nm ArF excimer)
Laser Manufacturer & Model.value: Teledyne CETAC Technologies Analyte G2 (193 nm ArF excimer)

ICP-MS Type.cell: Double-focusing sector field ICP-MS (explicitly stated: "Thermo Scientific Element XR double-focusing sector field ICP-MS unit")
ICP-MS Type.value: Double-focusing sector field ICP-MS (explicitly stated: "Thermo Scientific Element XR double-focusing sector field ICP-MS unit")

Interface Cone Configuration.cell: Al standard sample cone (1.1 mm aperture); Al H-type skimmer (0.8 mm aperture)
Interface Cone Configuration.value: Al standard sample cone (1.1 mm aperture); Al H-type skimmer (0.8 mm aperture)

Laser Spot Path / Ablation Mode.cell: all: grid of parallel, adjacent lines — §2.2.2; the grid runs 'from the metal-olivine margin to the olivine cores'

Laser Beam Energy Profile.cell: Flat-topped — 'The laser beam is characterized by a flat-topped energy profile' (§2.2.2)

Raster Line Spacing (Mapping Only).cell: Adjacent lines — 'a grid of parallel, adjacent lines using a 20 µm × 20 µm square-masked laser spot' (§2.2.2)

Carrier Gas and Flow Rate.cell: He: MFC-1 (cell) 0.200–0.260 l min⁻¹; MFC-2 (cup) 0.220–0.385 l min⁻¹
Carrier Gas and Flow Rate.value: He: MFC-1 (cell) 0.200–0.260 l min⁻¹; MFC-2 (cup) 0.220–0.385 l min⁻¹

Make-up Gas and Flow Rate.cell: Ar, 0.81–0.99 L/min — Table B1; 'No N2 was blent into ICP to avoid elevated nitrogen-based spectral interferences'

Plasma Thermal Mode.cell: all: cool plasma (800 W RF) — 'Cool plasma conditions (800 W RF power) were used to reduce Ar-based interferences and to increase the sensitivity of the analysis' (§2.2.2)

ICP Tuning.cell: N — oxide-based interferences 'were further minimized during tuning' (App. C4); no tuning procedure is described

Analysis Sequence.cell: N — the glasses were 'measured in the same analytical session' (§2.1); the sequence is not described

Target Species.cell: Mg, Al, Si, P, Sc, V, Cr, Mn, Fe, Ni, Ga, La, Eu, Pt — the 14 nuclides of the mapping (§2.2.2)

Monitored Masses.key: defines: monitored property per target species
Monitored Masses.cell: ²⁵Mg → Mg; ²⁷Al → Al; ²⁹Si → Si; ³¹P → P; ⁴⁵Sc → Sc; ⁵¹V → V; ⁵³Cr → Cr; ⁵⁵Mn → Mn; ⁵⁷Fe → Fe; ⁶⁰Ni → Ni; ⁷¹Ga → Ga; ¹³⁹La → La; ¹⁵³Eu → Eu; ¹⁹⁵Pt → Pt — 'a total scan cycle time of 1.944 s for 14 nuclides' (§2.2.2)

Reported Variables and Units.cell: Mg, Al, Si, P, Sc, V, Cr, Mn, Fe, Ni, Ga, La, Eu, Pt (concentration maps, µg/g); Fa#; principal-component scores — '2D concentration matrices of all target elements'; pure-olivine averages in Table E1

Dwell Time per Mass.cell: all: 0.01 s sample time — 10 samples per peak, mass window 100%, duty cycle 1.944 s (Table B1); the scan method 'speed-optimized'

Background Count Time.cell: 10 gas-blank scans before each line, 80 during ablation — Table B1
Background Count Time.value: 10 gas-blank scans before each line, 80 during ablation

Acquisition Pass.cell: map — a single pass: 'The laser scanned a grid of parallel, adjacent lines' (§2.2.2)

Internal Standard Approach.cell: all: sum normalization of MgO, FeO, SiO2 and P2O5 to 100 wt% in each pixel (Liu et al., 2008) — the oxide sum is a 'virtual, evenly distributed IS' (App. C1, equations 1–2)

value.value: sum normalization of MgO, FeO, SiO2 and P2O5 to 100 wt% in each pixel (Liu et al., 2008)

Internal Standard Element.cell: all: none — a virtual internal standard from the oxide sum (App. C1)

Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach.cell: P-rich veinlet pixels masked: P2O5 above the best-fitting Gaussian of each map's P2O5 histogram plus 3 standard deviations — §3.1; 'A MATLAB script was applied to mask pixels representing veinlets'
Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach.value: P-rich veinlet pixels masked: P2O5 above the best-fitting Gaussian of each map's P2O5 histogram plus 3 standard deviations

Blank / Background Correction Method.cell: Gas blank before each string of pixels; the average background preceding each analysis subtracted — App. C5
Blank / Background Correction Method.value: Gas blank before each string of pixels; the average background preceding each analysis subtracted

Pulse/Analog Detector Nonlinearity Corre.cell: N — 'Triple' detection (Table B1); a cross-calibration is not described

Spectral Interference Corrections Applie.cell: No mathematical correction — argide interferences reduced by cool plasma, oxide interferences 'less prevalent as a result of the dry plasma conditions and ... further minimized during tuning', and plasma-gas and atmospheric interferences 'corrected by background subtraction' (App. C4)

Interfering Species.cell: ²⁵Mg: ¹²C¹³C⁺; ²⁷Al: ¹³C¹⁴N⁺; ²⁹Si: ¹³C¹⁶O⁺ and ¹⁴N¹⁵N⁺; ³¹P: ¹⁵N¹⁶O⁺ and ¹³C¹⁸O⁺; ⁴⁵Sc: ²⁹Si¹⁶O⁺; ⁵¹V: ³⁵Cl¹⁶O⁺ and ⁴⁰Ar¹¹B⁺; ⁵³Cr: ⁴⁰Ar¹³C⁺ and ³⁷Cl¹⁶O⁺; ⁵⁵Mn: ⁴⁰Ar¹⁵N⁺ and ³⁹K¹⁶O⁺; ⁵⁷Fe: ⁴⁰Ar¹⁶O¹H⁺ and ³⁹K¹⁸O⁺; ⁶⁰Ni: ⁴⁴Ca¹⁶O⁺ and ²⁴Mg³⁶Ar⁺; ⁷¹Ga: ³¹P⁴⁰Ar⁺, ⁵⁵Mn¹⁶O⁺ and ⁵³Cr¹⁸O⁺; ¹⁵³Eu: ¹³⁷Ba¹⁶O⁺; other: N — Table C1, a 'non-exhaustive list', which also lists doubly charged ions

Interference Correction Method.cell: ⁶⁰Ni, ⁷¹Ga: argide interferences reduced by cool plasma conditions; other: N — 'argide-based interferences were reduced by the application of cool plasma conditions (e.g., 36Ar24Mg+ and 40Ar31P+ interferences for 60Ni and 71Ga, respectively)'; interferences present at all times are 'corrected by background subtraction' (App. C4)

value.value: argide interferences reduced by cool plasma conditions

Normalization / Standards-Based Correcti.cell: all: after calibration, each pixel re-normalised so that the MgO, FeO, SiO2 and P2O5 sum is 100 wt% — App. C1, equations 3–4; the per-pixel sums had 'varied between 95-99 wt %'

value.value: after calibration, each pixel re-normalised so that the MgO, FeO, SiO2 and P2O5 sum is 100 wt%

Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteri.cell: N — whole results are dropped, but on signal grounds: "where significant spikes in individual transient LA-ICP-MS signals were observed (e.g. Ca in CMS 04071 and Seymchan and Ni in Brahin and Seymchan), results were not included in Table 1" (p.6). By basis that belongs to Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach; no result-based selection rule is stated. For the maps, "The P-rich veinlets were excluded from the maps prior to the calculation of the correlation coefficients" (appendix C), which masks pixels within a result rather than admitting or excluding results

Combination Method.cell: all: average over the map pixels after masking the P-rich veinlets ('pure' olivine) — Fig. 4: 'to cancel out the input of the P2O5-rich veinlets to obtain average “pure” olivine values'

value.value: average over the map pixels after masking the P-rich veinlets ('pure' olivine)

Primary Calibration Standard Name.cell: all [all: NIST SRM 612, NIST SRM 614, USGS GSD-1G, USGS GSE-1G, BHVO-2G, BIR-1G] — linear regression on the internally normalised data; each glass processed as 3 replicate 2 mm line scans (§2.1, App. C1)

value.value: NIST SRM 612, NIST SRM 614, USGS GSD-1G, USGS GSE-1G, BHVO-2G, BIR-1G

Calibration Standard Measurement Frequen.cell: N — the glasses were 'measured in the same analytical session' (§2.1)

Detection Limit.cell: all: per-pixel LODs, averaged over the map — Table E1 (Na = 1, Nb = 10), App. C5

value.value: per-pixel LODs, averaged over the map

Detection Limit Method.cell: all: Longerich et al. (1996), LOD = 3SD/S × √(1/Nb + 1/Na) — Na = 1 and Nb = 10 for a pixel (App. C5)

Limit of Quantification (LOQ) Method.cell: all: as the LOD, with 10 SD instead of 3 SD — App. C5

value.value: as the LOD, with 10 SD instead of 3 SD

Counting Statistics Error.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Internal (Within-Measurement) Analytical.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Additional Notes.cell: Cool plasma (800 W) mapping with a lateral resolution of approximately 20 µm; P-rich veinlets masked before averaging (§2.2.2, §3.1)
Additional Notes.value: Cool plasma (800 W) mapping with a lateral resolution of approximately 20 µm; P-rich veinlets masked before averaging (§2.2.2, §3.1)
